    Success stories

    Chaos. Jwero. Outcome.

    Customer acquisition

    The problem

    “We were spending on ads and could not say what they brought.”

    What Jwero does

    Ads on Google and Instagram, tied to the enquiry and the bill, with a specialist tuning them.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Cost of each new customer
    • Enquiries per rupee spent
    • Sales traced to each ad

    Customer engagement

    The problem

    “We couldn’t keep up with customer enquiries.”

    What Jwero does

    AI replies on WhatsApp and Instagram, one shared inbox, the CRM behind it, and specialists watching quality.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Time to first reply
    • Enquiries answered
    • Enquiries that became bills

    Retention

    The problem

    “Old customers stopped coming and we did not notice.”

    What Jwero does

    Every customer’s occasions and taste on record, and outreach with a reason.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Customers who came back
    • Scheme renewals
    • Repeat purchase value

    Ecommerce

    The problem

    “Our website was a brochure nobody bought from.”

    What Jwero does

    A store priced at the live rate, a catalogue on every channel, and an ecommerce specialist running it.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Online orders
    • Enquiries from the site
    • Visitors who came back

    Marketing

    The problem

    “Three agencies, four tools, and no one account of what worked.”

    What Jwero does

    One team for content, social, campaigns and search, on one record.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Vendors replaced
    • Campaigns with a sales figure
    • Hours given back

    Operations

    The problem

    “The same thing was typed into five places.”

    What Jwero does

    One system for counter, stock, purchase, workshop and books, with the routine automated.

    The outcome, measured as

    • Tools replaced
    • Hours saved a week
    • Errors found the same day

    These are the patterns we work to, shown without figures. Named customer stories with their numbers will replace them as each customer agrees to publish. See the jewellers who run on Jwero.
